svg.title: Kumo Tabular small - classifier
svg.desc: NVIDIA - cell embedding -> column/row blocks -> in-context stack · 27.5 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); R: rows; C: columns. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input. How to read: × N: the block is stacked N times; alternating: Column block and Row block take turns, one of each per repeat, rather than one stack after the other; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; dot: the parameters in that stage, on a log scale shared by every tabfound diagram; the axis runs from the smallest dot to the largest; % is the stage's share of the total; hollow dot: one sublayer's parameters; "/ block" counts one copy of a stacked block; margin colour: the phase, from first (dark) to last (light); output shape: the tensor each stage emits, in the symbols above.
